name: New York
agencyName: New York State Department of Motor Vehicles

subRequirements.note: The test includes 4 road-sign questions; you must answer at least 2 of them correctly in addition to passing overall.

retake.retakeFee: Retakes are covered by the original permit application fee

gdl.nightCurfew: Junior license: no driving 9 p.m.-5 a.m. without an exception; stricter rules apply in NYC (no unsupervised driving) and Nassau/Suffolk/Long Island
gdl.passengerLimits: Junior license holders may carry no more than one passenger under 21 unless they are immediate family

requiredDocuments: Proof documents totaling 6 points (e.g. U.S. passport or birth certificate)
Proof of Social Security Number (or ineligibility)
Proof of New York State residency
process.realIdNotes: Choose a standard, REAL ID, or Enhanced document. REAL ID and Enhanced licenses require additional proof of identity, SSN, and New York residency using the DMV 6-point system.
process.permitFee: $64.25-$102.50 combined Class D/DJ fee (varies by age and MCTD region); covers the permit, written test, vision test, and first two road tests
process.licenseFee: Included in the combined learner permit/license fee
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 11 points within 18 months may result in suspension; a Driver Responsibility Assessment applies at 6 or more points in 18 months
facts.moveOverRule: Ambrose-Searles Move Over Act: move over or slow down for stopped emergency, hazard, and maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Varies; obey the posted school-zone limit and indicated hours or flashing signals
